description: Bug 4: Convert display-only FilterChip usages to AssistChip and fix controlled-but-broken FilterChip wiring. FilterChip is a toggle chip (aria-pressed) that shows a checkmark when selected — it must only be used for interactive filter toggles wired with selected+onSelectedChange. Pure display labels, count badges, and status chips must be AssistChip. 14 files affected. Independent from FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Read context.json at /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/.agents/tasks/task-mui-v2-regression/context.json and this FEAT file before touching any source. FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 must already be committed.

Decision rule for each chip: (A) Pure display label / badge — no onSelectedChange, no filter logic, just showing info → AssistChip, remove defaultSelected, keep leadingIcon/className. (B) Interactive filter toggle controlling visible state → keep FilterChip, wire with selected={value} + onSelectedChange={setter}, remove defaultSelected.

acceptance_criteria: No FilterChip is used as a pure display badge (those all show AssistChip).
Every remaining FilterChip usage has both selected={…} and onSelectedChange={…} props (no bare defaultSelected on a toggle).
AssistChip is imported in every file that uses it; FilterChip is removed from imports in files where it is no longer used.
findings: All 14 files updated. Display-only FilterChips converted to AssistChip with defaultSelected removed.
